contents.text:
I can’t directly modify messages or add reactions because I don’t have a tool for message actions.

If you tell me which platform msg_12345 is on (e.g., Slack, Discord, Teams, etc.), I can give you step-by-step instructions to add a 👍 reaction. 

In the meantime, I can help with:
- Checking the weather for a location
- Telling the current time (UTC or your local time)
